:::intro{robot="anatomy" title="Look closer, when you want to"}
This page takes the dialog apart to show how design decisions become the parts you see. You don't need it to use the dialog: [its own page](../dialog) has everything you need to build.

**Three easy ways in**

- Start with the drawing. Each number is one part, and the legend beside it names it.
- Want to know why a part looks the way it does? Its card follows the decision from the answer about the product, through the rule and the token, to what you see.
- Or start from a job, like Focus or Emphasis, and find every part that does it in the legend.

Come back whenever a part makes you wonder why.
:::

## Design roles

Each part does a job for the person. These are the jobs, as questions the part answers.

<div class="odv-am-rolelist"><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Containment</b> What holds this?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Layering</b> What sits on top?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Hierarchy</b> What do you read first?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Readability</b> Can you read it?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Emphasis</b> Where does the eye go?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Meaning</b> What state is it in?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Affordance</b> Can you act on it?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Feedback</b> Did it respond?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Focus</b> Where is the keyboard?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Grouping</b> What belongs together?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Reach</b> Can you hit it?</span></div>

## How the decisions reach each part

Each part follows a chain: an answer about the product, the rule it set, the token that carries it, and the value you see. The numbers match the drawing.

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-1-2"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox"><img class="odv-am-asset" src="/anatomy/multi-brand/dialog/card-1.png" alt="Panel and scrim: 1, 2" loading="lazy"/></span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">1</i><i class="odv-am-n">2</i><b>Panel and scrim</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="What holds this?">Containment</span><span class="odv-am-role" title="What sits on top?">Layering</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Elevation · What rises above the page? → Cards too</div><div class="odv-am-why">Cards lift slightly to group offers.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Elevation · How soft are shadows? → Soft</div><div class="odv-am-why">Soft shadows fit every brand.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Shape · What should control corners say? → Rounded</div><div class="odv-am-why">Rounded by default; each brand sets its own corner.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For a menu or dialog, use elevation.overlay and a dimmed page. Don't use no shadow.</div><div class="odv-am-why">The shadow shows a menu or dialog floats above the page. Without it, it blends into the cards.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.surface.scrim</code><span>→</span><code>overlay.background</code><span class="odv-am-val">#0000008C · dark #000000B3</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">The see-through layer behind a modal.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> black.light.scrim: a see-through layer that dims the page behind a modal, so the dialog is the one thing to act on.</div><div><b>Dark</b> black.dark.scrim: a see-through layer that dims the page behind a modal, so the dialog is the one thing to act on.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.surface.raised</code><span>→</span><code>content.background</code><span class="odv-am-val">#FFFFFF · dark #0F172A</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">Fills that float above content.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> neutral.0, the same as content (surface.default): a menu stands out by its edge and its one shadow, not by its fill.</div><div><b>Dark</b> neutral.50, the same as content (surface.default): a menu stands out by its edge and its one shadow, not by its fill, as in light.</div><div><b>Shares the step with</b> surface.default, action.secondary. Changing this pick moves only what reads color.surface.raised.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>elevation.overlay</code><span>→</span><code>content.shadow</code><span class="odv-am-val">0px 12px 32px, #0F172A29 · dark 0px 12px 32px, #00000080</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> shadow.overlay: Soft shadows fit every brand.</div><div><b>Dark</b> shadow.overlay-dark: Soft shadows fit every brand.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>radius.container</code><span>→</span><code>content.radius</code><span class="odv-am-val">0.5rem</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> radius.8: Rounded by default; each brand sets its own corner.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.border.default</code><span>→</span><code>content.border</code><span class="odv-am-val">#E2E8F0 · dark #334155</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">Quiet edges and dividers. Decorative, so it has no contrast minimum.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.18:1, on surface.canvas). It decorates, so it holds no contrast minimum.</div><div><b>Dark</b> neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.72:1, on surface.default). It decorates, so it holds no contrast minimum.</div><div><b>Shares the step with</b> surface.pressed, disabled.border. Changing this pick moves only what reads color.border.default.</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

Don't use a second primary.</div><div class="odv-am-why">The alternative steps back, so the one primary stays clear. ## For agents

Agents get this same anatomy: every part, its roles, whether it is required, the tokens it reads and the decisions behind them.

- **From an AI agent:** call the `get_anatomy` tool on the Open DS MCP server, with this scheme and `dialog`.
- **From a terminal:** `npx open-ds anatomy multi-brand dialog`
